common.sentence: 学校拟下月开放新图书馆，日期尚未确定。

language_specific.usage_note: 拟 introduces an intended action in formal writing; the opening date remains undecided.

common.sentence: 父亲去世时修桥的心愿未竟，儿子后来建好了桥。

language_specific.usage_note: 未竟 describes the father’s wish to build a bridge as unfulfilled at his death; his son later built the bridge.

common.sentence: 老师还没批准请假，小周明天得来上课。
common.note: 请假 means to request leave.

language_specific.usage_note: 还没批准 says approval has not been given yet; it does not state a refusal.

common.sentence: 安全规定不容违反，实验室禁止使用明火。
common.meaning: not permit; allow no room for
common.note: 明火 means an open flame.

language_specific.usage_note: 不容 expresses that violations of the safety rules cannot be tolerated.

common.sentence: 借用实验室钥匙须先登记姓名。

language_specific.usage_note: 须 states a requirement; it does not say whether registration has occurred.

common.sentence: 搬来之前，我未曾见过这条河。

language_specific.usage_note: 未曾 denies the experience before the stated past reference point.

common.sentence: 两份数据差别很大，原因有待调查。

language_specific.usage_note: 有待调查 presents investigation as still needed; the cause remains unresolved.

common.sentence: 雨下得太大，今晚不宜开车上山。

language_specific.usage_note: 不宜 advises against an action under the stated conditions; it does not itself impose a ban.

common.sentence: 调查结果尚未公布，我们未便透露细节。
common.meaning: not be in a position to; be inappropriate to

language_specific.usage_note: 未便 expresses a reservation about disclosing details while the investigation results are still unpublished.

common.sentence: 我在教室寻找钥匙未果，便去了失物处。
common.note: 失物处 means lost-and-found office.

language_specific.usage_note: 未果 follows an attempted action and reports that it produced no desired result.

common.sentence: 路上堵车，她未能赶上上午的面试。

language_specific.usage_note: 未能 presents the intended event as unrealized; the traffic provides the reason here.

common.sentence: 明天要交报告，我今晚无暇看电影。

language_specific.usage_note: 无暇 indicates a lack of time for the following activity.

common.sentence: 在那次旅行以前，他不曾坐过船。

language_specific.usage_note: 不曾 denies an experience before the specified past occasion.

common.sentence: 我本想提醒她，话到嘴边又咽了回去。
common.note: 话到嘴边 means the words were about to be spoken.

language_specific.pronunciation_note: Target: 咽 is read yàn, meaning swallow; 了 is neutral-toned.
language_specific.usage_note: 咽了回去 figuratively presents the words as held back rather than spoken; the intended reminder was not uttered.

common.sentence: 桌子太大，我们决定换一张小的。

language_specific.usage_note: 决定 states a decision to exchange the table; the exchange itself is not asserted as completed.

common.sentence: 钥匙找到了，你不必再换锁了。
common.note: 换锁 means to replace a lock.

language_specific.pronunciation_note: Target: 不 is pronounced bú before fourth-tone 必.
language_specific.usage_note: 不必 states that replacing the lock is unnecessary; it does not forbid doing so.

common.sentence: 我正在开会，不便接电话，稍后再联系你。
common.meaning: inconvenient to; not in a position to

language_specific.pronunciation_note: Target: 不 is pronounced bú before the fourth-tone syllable 便.
language_specific.usage_note: 不便 presents answering as inconvenient in the current circumstances and can soften the explanation.

common.sentence: 报告还没检查完，暂时不能发给客户。
common.note: 客户 means client.

language_specific.usage_note: 暂时 limits the inability to send the report to the present situation.

common.sentence: 本想周末去露营，天气预报有暴雨，便作罢了。

language_specific.usage_note: 作罢 refers back to the proposed camping trip and indicates that it was abandoned.

common.sentence: 我没注意到门口的纸条，直接进去了。
common.note: 纸条 means a slip of paper.

language_specific.usage_note: 没注意到 denies the result of noticing; it does not say whether the speaker looked toward the door.

common.sentence: 我检查了两遍，还是没发现那个错字。
common.note: 错字 means a wrongly written character.

language_specific.usage_note: 没发现 denies discovery of the error, although two checks occurred.

common.sentence: 这篇文章我这次还没读完，但以前读过一遍。

language_specific.usage_note: 还没读完 concerns the current reading; 读过一遍 establishes an earlier complete reading.

common.sentence: 我未及收拾阳台上的衣服，雨就下起来了。
common.meaning: not get a chance to in time

language_specific.usage_note: 未及 marks an action that had not been done before the next event occurred.

common.sentence: 这次面试她准备了很久，却没有通过。
common.note: 面试 means interview.

language_specific.usage_note: 没有通过 says she did not pass the interview, despite preparing for it.

common.sentence: 我只是提个建议，无意干涉你的选择。

language_specific.usage_note: 无意 plus a verb denies an intention to perform that action.

common.sentence: 这条路夜里灯少，步行难保安全。

language_specific.usage_note: 难保安全 expresses uncertainty about safety, not a claim that harm will occur.

common.sentence: 听说家人病了，她无心继续看书。
common.meaning: not be in the mood to

language_specific.usage_note: 无心 expresses a lack of inclination or attention for the activity in the circumstances.

common.sentence: 材料还没备齐，明天恐怕交不了。
common.note: 材料 means required materials.

language_specific.usage_note: 没备齐 means that some required materials are still missing; preparation may have started.

common.sentence: 这双鞋还没干透，明天不一定能穿。

language_specific.usage_note: 没干透 means the shoes are not completely dry; they may be partly dry.

common.sentence: 饭还没热透，不能拿给孩子吃。

language_specific.usage_note: 没热透 denies that the food has become hot throughout, though heating may be underway.

common.sentence: 一直盼着的雪没来，孩子们堆雪人的愿望落空了。
common.meaning: come to nothing; fail to materialize

language_specific.usage_note: 落空 describes a hope or expectation that was not fulfilled.

common.sentence: 听说山路结冰，他打消了独自上山的念头。

language_specific.usage_note: 打消 takes a thought or intention as its object and indicates that it has been given up.

common.sentence: 小王没关掉电脑，屏幕还亮着。
common.note: 屏幕 means screen.

language_specific.usage_note: 没关掉 denies that the computer was switched off; the lit screen supports its continuing state.

common.sentence: 会议结束了，但大家仍有未尽之言，明天继续讨论。

language_specific.usage_note: 未尽之言 refers to remarks not yet fully expressed; the meeting has ended, but discussion will continue tomorrow.

common.sentence: 主唱临时生病，周六的演出告吹了。

language_specific.usage_note: 告吹 says that a planned arrangement has fallen through.

common.sentence: 资金迟迟不到位，社区建花园的计划搁浅了。

language_specific.usage_note: 搁浅 figuratively describes a plan that cannot progress; it may resume later.

common.sentence: 双方的纠纷未了，律师仍在协助商谈。

language_specific.pronunciation_note: Target: 了 is read liǎo in 未了, not as the neutral-toned particle le.
language_specific.usage_note: 未了 describes the dispute as still unresolved; the negotiations continue.

common.sentence: 老师没收走词典，考试时还可以用。
common.note: 词典 means dictionary.

language_specific.usage_note: 没收走 says the teacher did not take the dictionary away; the next clause states that it remains available.

common.sentence: 看到弟弟穿着过大的雨靴走路，我不禁笑了。

language_specific.pronunciation_note: Target: 禁 is read jīn in 不禁.
language_specific.usage_note: 不禁 introduces an involuntary reaction to what the speaker sees.

common.sentence: 桌上的茶已经泡好了，客人随时可以喝。

language_specific.usage_note: 泡好了 presents the tea as prepared; 可以喝 expresses availability without asserting that anyone has drunk it.

common.sentence: 大桥经过三年施工，终于竣工，下月通车。

language_specific.usage_note: 竣工 marks the completion of a construction project; it does not itself mean that the bridge is open to traffic.

common.sentence: 院墙的修理工作已经完工，师傅正在收拾工具。
common.note: 院墙 means courtyard wall.

common.sentence: 村里的纪念馆落成那天，老人们都来了。
common.note: 纪念馆 means memorial hall.

language_specific.usage_note: 落成 refers to a building's completion and is often used when marking the occasion.

common.sentence: 村民合力建成了一座小桥，过河方便多了。

language_specific.usage_note: 成 marks the bridge as successfully built, with easier river crossing as the resulting change.

common.sentence: 经过多轮讨论，争论以双方道歉告终。

language_specific.usage_note: 以……告终 identifies the event or outcome that brings the dispute to an end.

common.sentence: 展览布置只剩最后一面墙，明天就能收尾。

language_specific.usage_note: 收尾 refers to handling the final tasks that bring ongoing work to completion.

common.sentence: 两人越吵越凶，最后以摔门收场。

language_specific.usage_note: 以……收场 describes how the quarrel ended; the ending here is unhappy.

common.sentence: 警方找回失物并查明经过，这起案件随即结案。

language_specific.usage_note: 结案 marks a case as formally closed; the sentence supplies the circumstances of this fictional case.

common.sentence: 他今天结清了欠朋友的钱，不再欠这位朋友钱了。

language_specific.usage_note: 结清 indicates that the outstanding amount has been fully settled.

common.sentence: 文章改了三遍才定稿，编辑随即送去排版。
common.note: 排版 means typesetting or layout.

language_specific.usage_note: 定稿 marks the text as settled after revision, ready for the next production step.

common.sentence: 经过几次修改，杯子的外形终于定型，可以生产了。

language_specific.usage_note: 定型 indicates that the design's form has been fixed after changes.

common.sentence: 她用泥捏小猫，身子和四肢已经成型。
common.note: 四肢 means the four limbs.

language_specific.usage_note: 成型 describes a recognizable form emerging; it need not mean that every detail is finished.

common.sentence: 讨论了几个地点后，大家敲定在河边聚餐。

language_specific.usage_note: 敲定 figuratively marks a choice as settled after consideration.

common.sentence: 预算还没定案，社团暂时不能订购设备。

language_specific.usage_note: 没定案 means the budget has not yet been finally decided; discussion may continue.

common.sentence: 漏水原因还在调查，现在下定论太早。

language_specific.usage_note: 下定论 means to arrive at a definitive conclusion; 太早 indicates that this has not yet been justified.

common.sentence: 雨突然下大了，摄影师决定提前收工，明天再拍。
common.meaning: stop work for the time being
common.note: 摄影师 means photographer.

language_specific.usage_note: 收工 refers to stopping the current work session; 决定 presents it as a decision, without asserting that work has already stopped.

common.sentence: 最后一场唱完，乐队的巡演在家乡收官。
common.meaning: bring a series to its conclusion
common.note: 巡演 means a performance tour.

language_specific.usage_note: 收官 figuratively marks the end of the whole tour, here with its final performance.

common.sentence: 新楼的主体结构今天封顶，里面还要装修。
common.meaning: complete the top of a building's structure

language_specific.usage_note: 封顶 marks completion of the building's structural top; interior work can remain.

common.sentence: 及格线是六十分，她这次考了六十五分，达标了。
common.note: 及格线 means the passing threshold.

language_specific.usage_note: 达标 indicates that the result meets the stated threshold.

common.sentence: 商量两小时后，双方达成协议，各自在文件上签字。

language_specific.usage_note: 达成协议 states that the parties reached an agreement; the signatures follow that outcome.

common.sentence: 她答应陪孩子看海，暑假时终于兑现了承诺。

language_specific.usage_note: 兑现承诺 means to carry out what one promised.

common.sentence: 演员已经上台，灯光和音响也已就绪。

language_specific.usage_note: 就绪 describes the lighting and sound equipment as ready for the performance.

common.sentence: 帐篷、食物和水都已齐备，我们明早出发。

language_specific.usage_note: 齐备 describes the necessary items as all present and ready.

common.sentence: 门轴涂油后，这个办法奏效了，开门不再响。
common.note: 门轴 means door hinge.

language_specific.usage_note: 奏效 reports that the measure worked; the quiet door shows the effect.

common.sentence: 社团的新约定从周一生效，活动时间改为六点。

language_specific.usage_note: 生效 marks the point from which the agreed arrangement applies.

common.sentence: 门禁卡过期后失效了，她刷卡也进不了门。
common.meaning: cease to be valid or effective
common.note: 门禁卡 means access card.

language_specific.usage_note: 失效 describes the card's loss of validity; it no longer opens the door.

common.sentence: 店员填错了金额，把旧收据作废后重开一张。
common.note: 收据 means receipt.

language_specific.usage_note: 把……作废 describes deliberately invalidating the old receipt.

common.sentence: 店里今天准备的面包已经告罄，明早才有新货。

language_specific.usage_note: 告罄 refers to the exhaustion of the specified supply, here today's bread.

common.sentence: 这场演出的票昨天售罄，今天买不到了。

language_specific.usage_note: 售罄 means all tickets in the stated supply have been sold.

common.sentence: 手电筒的电量耗尽了，灯光彻底熄灭。
common.note: 手电筒 means flashlight.

language_specific.usage_note: 耗尽 marks the battery's available power as fully used up.

common.sentence: 提交申请前，请留存一份表格，方便以后查询。

language_specific.usage_note: 留存 asks the reader to keep a copy available for later reference.

common.sentence: 旧房翻修后，仍遗留着屋顶漏水的问题。
common.meaning: remain unresolved from an earlier time
common.note: 翻修 means renovation.

language_specific.usage_note: 遗留着 describes a preexisting problem that remains after the renovation.

common.sentence: 擦过桌子后，桌角仍残留着一点油渍。
common.note: 油渍 means an oily stain.

language_specific.usage_note: 残留 describes a small amount left behind after an attempt to remove it.

common.sentence: 连下三天雨，院子低处积存了不少水。

language_specific.usage_note: 积存 describes water collecting over time and remaining in the low area.

common.sentence: 水库经过一季雨水补充，已经蓄满。
common.meaning: fill to capacity by accumulating water
common.note: 水库 means reservoir.

language_specific.usage_note: 蓄满 describes the reservoir reaching its full storage capacity.

common.sentence: 出发前，他用水管把水箱灌满了清水。
common.meaning: fill completely by pouring or pumping

language_specific.usage_note: In this 把 construction, the container comes before 灌满 and its contents follow.

common.sentence: 她不断往水里加盐，直到饱和，盐不再溶解。
common.note: 溶解 means to dissolve.

language_specific.usage_note: 饱和 describes the solution reaching a state in which no more salt dissolves under those conditions.

common.sentence: 雨从早到晚没有停歇，院子里积了一层水。

language_specific.usage_note: 没有停歇 means the rain continued without a break over the stated interval.

common.sentence: 影片结束时，画面定格在两人拥抱的瞬间。
common.note: 瞬间 means an instant.

language_specific.usage_note: 画面定格在…… means the moving image stops on a particular frame.

common.sentence: 客人们坐定后，主人给每人倒了一杯茶。

language_specific.usage_note: 坐定 marks the guests as seated and settled before the tea is poured.

common.sentence: 她曾在山村教书，如今在城里工作。

language_specific.usage_note: 曾 is a standalone adverb that places the teaching in an earlier period.

common.sentence: 去年徒步时，我们领略了山谷的宁静。

language_specific.usage_note: 领略 conveys direct appreciation of a quality experienced by the subject.

common.sentence: 跟着师傅修了一天船，我见识了他的手艺。

language_specific.pronunciation_note: Target: 识 is neutral-toned in the verb 见识.
language_specific.usage_note: 见识 describes gaining firsthand knowledge through what one sees or experiences.

common.sentence: 她尝试用纸板做模型，第一次没成功。

language_specific.usage_note: 尝试 reports an actual attempt; it does not imply success.

common.sentence: 暑假我体验了一周农场生活，学会了挤牛奶。

language_specific.usage_note: 体验 emphasizes personally taking part in and feeling a way of life or activity.

common.sentence: 那次停电我们经历了漫长的一夜，天亮才来电。

language_specific.pronunciation_note: Target: 历 has fourth tone, unlike 理 in 经理 jīnglǐ.

common.sentence: 父亲亲历了那场大火，讲述时仍记得烟味。

language_specific.usage_note: 亲历 stresses that the subject was personally present for the event.

common.sentence: 她以前画插画，去年首次涉足动画制作。
common.meaning: enter or become involved in a field

language_specific.usage_note: 涉足 figuratively describes entering an area of activity, here animation production.

common.sentence: 实习时我接触过木版印刷，还亲手刻了一块版。

language_specific.usage_note: 接触 refers to becoming acquainted with a technique through actual exposure.

common.sentence: 我在路口目睹了碰撞，随后向警察说明情况。
我曾耳闻那座桥很窄，直到昨天才亲眼见到。

language_specific.usage_note: 耳闻 attributes the earlier claim about the bridge to what the speaker heard, before seeing it personally.

common.sentence: 早先商量的是周六出发，后来改成了周日。

language_specific.usage_note: 早先 refers to the earlier arrangement, which was later changed.

common.sentence: 雨从午后持续到傍晚，院里的水越积越深。
老校舍关了，校友们的读书会却延续至今。

language_specific.usage_note: 延续 describes the reading group continuing up to the present despite the closure of the old school building.

common.sentence: 新负责人沿用旧表格，大家对填写方式很熟悉。
common.meaning: continue to use an established practice or item

language_specific.usage_note: 沿用 indicates continued use of something already established.

common.sentence: 路面结冰，她走下坡时保持缓慢的步速。

language_specific.usage_note: 保持 describes maintaining a particular speed during the descent.

common.sentence: 翻修后，老屋保留了原来的木门和窗框。

language_specific.usage_note: 保留 here means that existing physical features were kept during renovation.

common.sentence: 听完那封信，她低着头，久久没有说话。

language_specific.pronunciation_note: Target: The first 久 is pronounced with a rising second tone before the third tone of the second 久.
language_specific.usage_note: 久久 emphasizes the extended duration of her silence.

common.sentence: 两人毕业后通信多年，友谊长久不衰。
common.note: 不衰 means not fading or weakening.

language_specific.usage_note: 长久不衰 describes the friendship as lasting without fading.

common.sentence: 多年没见，老同学依旧记得我的小名。

language_specific.usage_note: 依旧 marks the memory as persisting despite the years apart.

common.sentence: 换了新电池，钟表仍旧走得不准。

language_specific.usage_note: 仍旧 marks the inaccuracy as persisting despite the battery change.

common.sentence: 展览开幕一周了，迄今已有三百人参观。

language_specific.usage_note: 迄今 sets the present as the endpoint for the accumulated visitor count.

common.sentence: 他向来给借来的书包上书皮，这次也一样。
common.note: 书皮 means a protective book cover here.

language_specific.usage_note: 向来 describes an established habit up to the present occasion.

common.sentence: 这个合唱团历来由成员选指挥，今年也如此。

language_specific.usage_note: 历来 describes a practice across the group's history through the current year.

common.sentence: 她一向自己修自行车，这次也没去车店。

language_specific.pronunciation_note: Target: 一 is pronounced yí before fourth-tone 向.
language_specific.usage_note: 一向 describes her established habit of repairing her bicycle herself.

common.sentence: 他一贯按时交稿，这次迟交让编辑很意外。

language_specific.pronunciation_note: Target: 一 is pronounced yí before fourth-tone 贯.
language_specific.usage_note: 一贯 describes a consistent established pattern; the late submission is an exception.

common.sentence: 图书馆新近添置了几台电脑，读者已经用上了。

language_specific.usage_note: 新近 places the acquisition in the recent past.

common.sentence: 近来夜里常有猫叫，我睡觉前会关紧窗户。

language_specific.usage_note: 近来 sets a recent period during which the calls have recurred.

common.sentence: 社区近日开了一间工具借用室，居民可以借用。
common.meaning: in the past few days; recently

language_specific.usage_note: 近日 places the opening in the recent past in this sentence.

common.sentence: 校队日前公布了新队长，队员们正在商量训练安排。

language_specific.usage_note: 日前 refers to a recent past time without specifying the exact day.

common.sentence: 天刚亮，山间的几座房屋渐次显露出来。

language_specific.usage_note: 渐次 presents the houses as becoming visible gradually, one after another.

common.sentence: 经过几个月练习，她逐步掌握了换气的方法。

language_specific.usage_note: 逐步 presents mastery as developing in stages over the practice period.

common.sentence: 昨晚风很大，院里接连掉下好几根树枝。

language_specific.usage_note: 接连 describes several branches falling in succession during the storm.

common.sentence: 上周停水修管道，今天上午再度停水。

language_specific.usage_note: 再度 marks the new interruption as another occurrence after the previous one.

common.sentence: 项目暂停半年后，本周团队重启了调查。

language_specific.pronunciation_note: Target: 重 is pronounced chóng in 重启.
language_specific.usage_note: 重启 describes starting the suspended investigation again.

common.sentence: 连日降雨后，干枯的草地渐渐复苏，冒出了新芽。

language_specific.usage_note: 复苏 describes a return of vitality after decline or dormancy.

common.sentence: 碎陶碗经过修补，如今已复原，放回了展柜。
common.meaning: return to an earlier form or condition

language_specific.usage_note: 复原 describes the damaged bowl returning to its earlier form after repair.

common.sentence: 雾散后，对岸的灯光重现，船夫看清了方向。

language_specific.pronunciation_note: Target: 重 is pronounced chóng in 重现.
language_specific.usage_note: 重现 describes the lights becoming visible again after the fog obscured them.
